title: Why a question is or is not statistical
observableEvidence: Explains, by choosing reasons, that a question is statistical because its data vary, not because its answer is a number, for two questions that both have numerical answers.
prompt: Two questions are asked about the families on Maple Street. Question 1: "How many pets does each family on Maple Street have?" Question 2: "How many families live on Maple Street?" Both answers are numbers. Question 1 is a statistical question and Question 2 is not. Choose the reason for each.
solutionRepresentation: Question 1 collects one count from every family, and different families are expected to have different numbers of pets, so the data vary. Question 2 has one answer, a single count of families, which does not vary. "Its answer is a number" cannot be the reason, because both answers are numbers.
solutionMethod: Decide each case by whether the question collects data that vary, not by the form of the answer or the topic.

deterministicValidator.canonicalAnswer: Why Question 1 is statistical: Families are expected to have different numbers of pets; Why Question 2 is not statistical: It has one answer, a single count that does not vary
acceptedAnswers: Why Question 1 is statistical: Families are expected to have different numbers of pets; Why Question 2 is not statistical: It has one answer, a single count that does not vary

hintSteps.prompt: Both questions have numbers as answers, so the form of the answer cannot be what separates them.
hintSteps.question: If you asked every family on Maple Street Question 1, would all the responses be the same?

hintSteps.prompt: Compare how many values each question produces: one value for the whole street, or one value from each family.
hintSteps.question: At one moment in time, how many different correct answers could Question 2 have?

hintSteps.prompt: A different example: "How many books does each student own?" is statistical because the counts change from student to student; "How many students are in the club?" is not, because the club has just one total.
hintSteps.question: Which listed reasons describe those same ideas for the Maple Street questions?
